//: NEON_MDF_PATH: giong IDF_PATH cua ESP-IDF. VSCode KHONG luon ke thua bien moi truong shell (vd mo qua Dock/Spotlight) - set day de chac chan CMake Tools va integrated terminal deu thay, khong phu thuoc nguoi dung nho `source neon-mdf/export.sh` truoc. Duong dan __NEON_MDF_RELATIVE_PATH__ duoc extension tinh THAT (tuong doi tu vi tri app nay toi SDK dang chon, xem neonMdf.sdkPath setting + lenh 'NEON-MDF: Chon Duong Dan SDK...') luc tao app - neu doi vi tri app hoac SDK sau nay, sua lai day cho dung.
